description: Land Title Settle Department - Makuluwa, Galle Four Grarets, D/S Division, Galle District - Cad. Map No. 810013
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and property characteristics) in various villages in Galle District. The content focuses on land ownership registration, property boundaries, and title settlement - all falling under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
